parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
The personal access token.
This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or a Security Token Service (STS) temporary token for authentication.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can find the organization ID in your Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL, for example, https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The ID or full path of the repository.
